title: Does Palantir’s Agentic Moat Finally Justify Its Premium Valuation Multiple?
excerpt: Palantir just posted a quarter that left investors speechless, but trading at 150 times earnings with rivals racing to close the gap, the real question is wh...
content_html:
Joey Frenette

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 8:18 AM PDT 5 min read

Quick Read

  • Palantir's ontological moat and AIP bootcamp strategy make it an early leader in high-margin agentic AI software adoption.

  • At 150x trailing P/E, Palantir's valuation looks stretched, and Dr. Michael Burry warns frontier AI labs could disrupt its edge.

  • It sounds nuts, but SoFi1 is giving new Active Invest users up to $3,000 in stock for a limited time, and all it takes is a $50 deposit to get started.2 See for yourself (Sponsor)

Could it be that Palantir (NASDAQ:PLTR) is already on the right path to justifying its seemingly absurd pie-in-the-sky valuation? Or is the AI data analytics firm just experiencing a hot, multi-quarter streak that could eventually peak out as a rapid revenue and margin deceleration (or maybe even a descent) takes its place?

These are questions that only time will tell, but, in the meantime, shares of Palantir are back on the high track following that "otherworldly" quarter against some sky-high expectations. Any way you look at it, investors will probably be talking about that second quarter for years to come. But whether it's just the start of something even more fierce remains the trillion-dollar question.

Surely Palantir can't be the only high-margin hyper-grower in AI software

As AI investors look well beyond just large language model capabilities, which are apparently being commoditized, for agentic orchestration and some grounding in the truth (think the ontological moat the Palantir brings to the table), Palantir may very well be the first of many AI software companies that enters an era of high-margin growth as AI agents start doing real work in the trenches while unlocking serious value that might even cause investors to question why the hyperscalers weren't being as aggressive as they could be with the initial AI data center buildout.

SoFi Active Invest is offering a limited-time promotion. Open an account, fund it with $50 or more, and you could receive up to $3,000 in complimentary stock for Active Invest accounts. See for yourself by clicking here now. (Sponsor)

Either way, it's hard to bet against Palantir as the company looks to bring its powerful AI Platform (AIP) to even more commercial users while leveraging bootcamps to accelerate enterprise adoption. In my humble opinion, Palantir's latest quarterly blowout suggests that investors ought to focus just a bit more on how AI compute is being used rather than how much it's being put to work across the board.

For rivals to catch Palantir, the shift towards compute-based or even outcome-based consumption, I think, is a must. As Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) moves through a violent transition – one that won't see every software company successfully pivot to the AI era — I do think that investors should consider if firms have the right moats in place to thrive in a very different, higher-stakes era for enterprise software.

Palantir（纳斯达克股票代码：PLTR）是否已经走在正确的道路上，证明其看似荒谬的天上掉馅饼的估值是合理的？ 或者，这家人工智能数据分析公司是否刚刚经历了连续多个季度的热潮，最终可能会随着收入和利润率的快速减速（甚至可能下降）而达到顶峰？

这些问题只有时间才能给出答案，但与此同时，Palantir 的股价在经历了这个“超凡脱俗”的季度后，超出了一些天价预期，重新回到了高位。 无论从哪个角度来看，投资者可能会在未来几年里谈论第二季度。 但这是否只是更激烈的事情的开始仍然是一个价值数万亿美元的问题。

当然，Palantir 不可能是人工智能软件领域唯一一家高利润的超级增长者

由于人工智能投资者不仅仅关注大型语言模型功能（这些功能显然正在商品化），还关注代理编排和一些事实基础（想想 Palantir 带来的本体论护城河），Palantir 很可能成为许多人工智能软件公司中第一家进入高利润增长时代的公司，因为人工智能代理开始在战壕中做实际工作，同时释放重要的价值，这甚至可能会让投资者质疑为什么超大规模企业没有像他们对初始人工智能数据那样积极主动中心扩建。

无论哪种方式，都很难对 Palantir 下注，因为该公司希望将其强大的人工智能平台 (AIP) 带给更多的商业用户，同时利用训练营来加速企业采用。 在我看来，Palantir 最新的季度井喷表明投资者应该更多地关注人工智能计算的使用方式，而不是全面使用人工智能计算的程度。

我认为，对于竞争对手来说，要想赶上 Palantir，必须转向基于计算甚至基于结果的消费。 随着软件即服务 (SaaS) 经历一场剧烈的转型——不会看到每家软件公司都能成功转向人工智能时代——我确实认为投资者应该考虑公司是否拥有合适的护城河，可以在一个非常不同、风险更高的企业软件时代蓬勃发展。
